question.text: At a particular height, the velocity of an ascending body is $\mathbf{u}$. The velocity at the same height while the body falls freely is

solution.text: Given that velocity of ascending body = u Let there is no air resistance when body falls freely in downward direction, the direction of falling body will opposite to the ascending body. $\therefore$ The velocily at the same height while the body falls freely $=-u$
